# pdfmonkey-node

> Official Node.js/TypeScript SDK for the PDFMonkey API. Generate PDFs from HTML/CSS templates. Zero runtime dependencies, dual ESM + CommonJS.

## Installation

```sh
npm install pdfmonkey
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { PDFMonkey } from 'pdfmonkey';

const client = new PDFMonkey('your-api-key');

// Generate a PDF synchronously (blocks until ready)
const card = await client.documents.generateSync({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  payload: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Alice', amount: 42 }),
});
console.log(card.download_url);
```

## Client Configuration

```ts
const client = new PDFMonkey({
  apiKey: 'your-api-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.pdfmonkey.io/api/v1', // default
  timeout: 30_000,    // ms, default 30s
  maxRetries: 2,      // retries on 429/5xx, default 2
  fetch: customFetch,  // optional custom fetch
  logger: console,     // optional debug logger
});
```

## Resources

### Documents

```ts
// Create (starts as draft unless status: 'pending')
const doc = await client.documents.create({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  payload: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Alice' }),
  status: 'pending',
});

// Get by ID
const doc = await client.documents.get('doc_xxx');

// Update (uses PUT)
const updated = await client.documents.update('doc_xxx', {
  payload: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Bob' }),
});

// Delete
await client.documents.delete('doc_xxx');
```

#### Synchronous Generation

Blocks until PDF is ready. Returns a `DocumentCard`.

```ts
const card = await client.documents.generateSync({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  payload: JSON.stringify({ invoice: 1234 }),
});
console.log(card.download_url);
```

#### Polling for Completion

```ts
const doc = await client.documents.create({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  payload: JSON.stringify({ data: 'value' }),
  status: 'pending',
});

const completed = await client.documents.waitForGeneration(doc.id, {
  interval: 2000,  // poll every 2s (default)
  timeout: 120000, // give up after 120s (default)
  signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000), // optional AbortSignal
});
```

#### Document Meta (Password & Filename)

The `meta` field accepts an object (auto-serialized) or a JSON string.

```ts
await client.documents.create({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  meta: {
    _password: 'secret123',      // encrypts PDF with AES-256
    _filename: 'invoice-42.pdf', // sets download filename
    customField: 'any value',    // your own metadata
  },
  status: 'pending',
});
```

Works on `create`, `update`, and `generateSync`.

#### DocumentStatus Type

`DocumentStatus` is a union type shared by `Document` and `DocumentCard`:

```ts
type DocumentStatus = 'draft' | 'pending' | 'generating' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'error';
```

### Document Cards (read-only)

```ts
// List with filters (status accepts DocumentStatus values)
const page = await client.documentCards.list({
  document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx',
  status: 'success',
  workspace_id: 'ws_xxx',
  updated_since: 1700000000,
  page: 1,
});

// Get by ID
const card = await client.documentCards.get('card_xxx');
```

### Document Templates

```ts
const page = await client.documentTemplates.list({ workspace_id: 'ws_xxx' });
const tpl = await client.documentTemplates.get('tpl_xxx');
const created = await client.documentTemplates.create({ identifier: 'invoice' });
const updated = await client.documentTemplates.update('tpl_xxx', { identifier: 'receipt' });
await client.documentTemplates.delete('tpl_xxx');
```

> **Do not set `pdf_engine_draft_id` when creating templates.** Leave it
> undefined and the API auto-selects the latest engine — the right default
> in nearly all cases. Override only when an end-user explicitly asks to pin
> a specific engine version.

### PDF Engines (read-only, advanced)

Use only when an end-user explicitly wants to pin a template to a specific
engine version. Otherwise leave `pdf_engine_draft_id` unset on template
creation and the API picks the latest engine automatically.

```ts
const engines = await client.pdfEngines.list();
// [{ id: 'eng_xxx', name: 'chromium', version: 6, deprecated_on: null }, ...]
```

### Template Folders

```ts
const page = await client.templateFolders.list();
const folder = await client.templateFolders.get('fold_xxx');
const created = await client.templateFolders.create({ identifier: 'invoices' });
const updated = await client.templateFolders.update('fold_xxx', { identifier: 'reports' });
await client.templateFolders.delete('fold_xxx');
```

### Snippets

Reusable HTML partials shared across templates.

```ts
const page = await client.snippets.list();
const snippet = await client.snippets.get('snp_xxx');
const created = await client.snippets.create({
  identifier: 'header',
  code: '<div>Header</div>',
  workspace_id: 'ws_xxx',
});
const updated = await client.snippets.update('snp_xxx', { code: '<div>Updated</div>' });
await client.snippets.delete('snp_xxx');
```

### Workspaces (read-only)

```ts
const page = await client.workspaces.list();
const ws = await client.workspaces.get('ws_xxx');
```

### Current User (read-only)

```ts
const user = await client.currentUser.get();
// user.email, user.current_plan, user.available_documents
```

### Webhooks (RestHooks)

```ts
// Register a webhook
const hook = await client.restHooks.create({
  url: 'https://example.com/webhook',
  events: ['document.done'],
  workspace_id: 'ws_xxx',              // optional
  document_template_ids: ['tpl_xxx'],   // optional
});

// Delete a webhook
await client.restHooks.delete('hook_xxx');
```

#### Verify Incoming Webhooks

```ts
import { verifyWebhook } from 'pdfmonkey';

const event = await verifyWebhook(
  rawBody,                              // raw request body string
  {
    'svix-id': headers['svix-id'],
    'svix-timestamp': headers['svix-timestamp'],
    'svix-signature': headers['svix-signature'],
  },
  process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET,           // with or without 'whsec_' prefix
);

event.type; // 'document.done'
event.data; // { id: 'doc_xxx', ... }
```

## Pagination

All `.list()` methods return `Page<T>`:

```ts
const page = await client.documentCards.list({ document_template_id: 'tpl_xxx' });

page.data;          // readonly T[] — items on this page
page.currentPage;   // number
page.totalPages;    // number
page.hasNextPage(); // boolean
page.hasPreviousPage(); // boolean

const next = await page.getNextPage();     // throws if no next page
const prev = await page.getPreviousPage(); // throws if no previous page
```

## Error Handling

All errors extend `PDFMonkeyError`.

```ts
import {
  APIError,
  APIConnectionError,
  AuthenticationError,    // 401
  NotFoundError,          // 404
  UnprocessableEntityError, // 422
  RateLimitError,         // 429
  InternalServerError,    // 500+
} from 'pdfmonkey';

try {
  await client.documents.get('doc_xxx');
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof RateLimitError) {
    error.status;     // 429
    error.retryAfter; // seconds from Retry-After header, or undefined
    error.headers;    // Response headers
    error.body;       // Raw response body
  }
  if (error instanceof APIConnectionError) {
    error.cause;      // Original network error (native Error.cause)
  }
}
```

Retries: the client automatically retries on 429 and 5xx errors (configurable via `maxRetries`). 401, 404, and 422 are never retried.

## Key Types

```ts
import type {
  Document,
  DocumentCard,
  DocumentCreateParams,
  DocumentMeta,
  DocumentStatus,
  DocumentUpdateParams,
  GenerateSyncParams,
  WaitForGenerationOptions,
  DocumentTemplate,
  DocumentTemplateCard,
  DocumentTemplateCreateParams,
  DocumentTemplateUpdateParams,
  DocumentTemplateListParams,
  DocumentCardListParams,
  TemplateFolder,
  TemplateFolderCreateParams,
  TemplateFolderUpdateParams,
  Snippet,
  SnippetCreateParams,
  SnippetUpdateParams,
  RestHook,
  RestHookCreateParams,
  Workspace,
  CurrentUser,
  WebhookEvent,
  WebhookHeaders,
  Page,
  PaginationMeta,
  ClientOptions,
  RequestOptions,
} from 'pdfmonkey';
```

## API Notes

- Base URL: `https://api.pdfmonkey.io/api/v1`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`
- Updates use **PUT** (not PATCH)
- Response envelope: `{ "document": {...} }`, `{ "snippets": [...], "meta": {...} }`
- Pagination: `page[number]` query param; meta includes `current_page`, `total_pages`, `next_page`, `prev_page`
- `payload` and `meta` are JSON-encoded strings in the API; the SDK auto-serializes `meta` objects
- Webhooks use Svix HMAC-SHA256 signatures with 5-minute timestamp tolerance
